blocks.text: Pani hydrogen ka oxide hai aur is ka chemical formula H₂O hai. Dekhne mein yeh saada sa molecule hai, magar is ki bohat si hairan kun properties (khususiyaat) hain, jin ki wajah se isay “the medium of life” (zindagi ka zariya) kaha jata hai. Hamare jism ka taqreeban do tihai (2/3) hissa pani hai aur hum is ke baghair zinda nahin reh sakte. Asal mein yeh tamam jandaron mein sab se zyada paya jane wala compound hai. Mukhtalif jandaron mein is ki miqdar 65 se 89 percent tak hoti hai. Multicellular (bohat se cells wale) jandaron mein yeh tissue se tissue badalti hai: maslan bone (haddi) ke cells mein taqreeban 20 percent aur brain (dimagh) ke cells mein 85 percent pani hota hai. Pani zindagi ke maadde (protoplasm) ko banane aur qaim rakhne mein, aur zindagi ke kaam ke liye munasib mahol (environment) banane mein aham kirdar ada karta hai. Pani ki bohat si aham properties isay zindagi ke liye zaroori banati hain.
